stem: Andrew would like to provide a better sentence to introduce the ideas in the fifth paragraph (sentences 27–31). Which of these could replace sentence 27 and provide a more effective topic sentence for this paragraph?

options.label: F
options.text: Readers sometimes ask Kinney why his books are so popular.

options.label: G
options.text: There are readers who like to ask Kinney some stuff.

options.label: H
options.text: Readers want Kinney to tell them more about his choices.

options.label: J
options.text: The people who read the books want to know more.
